answer: I would like to talk about a man whose kindness is known throughout our neighbourhood. The most generous person I know is an old family friend who seems to find genuine joy in giving. For many years he ran a shop next to my father's in the market, so I have known him since I was a small boy, and he still calls me by my childhood nickname. His generosity is not just about money, though he is quietly charitable; it is more about his time and attention. Whenever anyone is in trouble, he is the first to offer help, often before being asked. What makes his kindness so [[genuine]] is that he never seeks recognition for it; in fact, he prefers to help [[discreetly]]. I remember him supporting a struggling family in our neighbourhood for months without anyone knowing, paying their children's school fees until the father found work again. I only found out years later, through my father. During Ramadan, he also quietly sends food to families who cannot afford much for iftar. I think true generosity like his is increasingly [[uncommon]] in a world that often prizes self-interest. As for how I feel about him, I have enormous respect for him, and being around him is a gentle reminder to be more giving myself. He genuinely believes that we are all better off when we look after one another, and he lives by that principle. Honestly, his [[benevolence]] has left a lasting impression on everyone who knows him.

followUps.q: Do you think people in your country are generous?
followUps.answer: Generally, yes. Charity is an important part of our culture and religion, especially during Ramadan and Eid, when people make a real effort to share food and money with those who are [[less fortunate]].

followUps.q: Is it better to give money or time?
followUps.answer: Both matter, but I think time is often more valuable. Money solves immediate problems, whereas giving someone your time and attention shows that you genuinely care about them as a person.

note: Added how I know him (shop next to my father's), a concrete example of his discreet help, Ramadan charity and a clear 'how I feel' section.
